name: Divine Heart Machina ~Haijoku no Intsui Senshi~
original_name: ディバインハート マキナ～敗辱の淫墜戦士～
source:
Kurusu Makina is a super weapon and modified human born from the demonic secret society "Millennium".

Just before undergoing the devilish brainwashing operation, Makina escapes from the organization's laboratory with the help of her father, who risks his life.
While living as a schoolgirl, she becomes a female warrior of justice "Divine Heart Makina" and
spends her days fighting the hateful secret society that killed her father.
Her only ally is herself, the unyielding "Divine Heart Makina". Her
enemies are the monsters of "Millennium" who have gained demonic powers to fulfill their evil desires through body modification.

With her younger sister standing in her way as a dark heroine, and facing a doomed situation where she will be brainwashed and modified by lewd devilish rape if she is defeated,
Makina continues to fight alone...

Will Makina be able to escape the schemes of Millennium executive "Mido" and safely rescue her younger sister who is stained by evil impulses?

Set in the near-future city of Geopolis, a lonely battle steeped in mind invasion and monster rape begins now!
translation:
来栖·玛基纳是从恶魔秘密社团“千禧年”诞生的超级武器和改造人类。

就在接受邪恶的洗脑手术之前，马基娜在父亲的帮助下冒着生命危险逃离了该组织的实验室。
在女学生的生活中，她成为了正义的女战士“神心玛琪娜”，
她整天与杀害她父亲的可恨秘密社团作斗争。
她唯一的盟友就是她自己，不屈的“神心玛基娜”。她的
敌人是“千年”的怪物，他们通过身体改造获得了恶魔的力量来满足他们的邪恶欲望。

身为黑暗女主角的妹妹挡在了她的路上，一旦失败，她将面临被淫魔强奸洗脑和改造的宿命，
玛吉娜继续孤军奋战……

玛琪娜能否逃脱千禧年执行官“米多”的阴谋，安全救出被邪恶冲动玷污的妹妹呢？

以近未来的吉奥波利斯市为背景，一场充满心灵入侵和怪物强奸的孤独战斗现在开始了！
